title: A Year on AI: Success or Scam?
titleRu: Год на ИИ: успе́х или обма́н?
description: On Thanksgiving, Steven talks about his week of using AI tools like Claude, Muse and Gemini to post his podcast to Instagram automatically, and asks whether the word "American" really fits a Canadian. He admits his AI experiments are losing money for now, gives himself one year to make his own business work, and shares news about student essays, an odd email and a café near his home that closed.

sentences.en: The main points in brief

sentences.en: Now he doesn't need new programs.

sentences.zh: Монти́рует ему́ Claude.

sentences.zh: Ка́ждое — по 45 секу́нд.

sentences.en: He said: "This is exactly what I was afraid of. I just don't want to look at my own face anymore."

sentences.zh: А Claude де́лает все 13 сра́зу.
sentences.en: And Claude does all 13 at once.

sentences.en: How do you deal with this?

sentences.zh: Инстаграм без рук

sentences.zh: Стивен рабо́тал над э́тим всю неде́лю.

sentences.en: But it turned out great!

sentences.zh: А Gemini проверя́ет ка́чество.

sentences.en: It writes articles in Steven's voice.

sentences.zh: И смо́трит ви́део.
sentences.en: And it watches videos.

sentences.en: Other programs can't do that.

sentences.zh: Gemini проверя́ет и комиксы Стивена для изуче́ния англи́йского.

sentences.zh: В не́которых отве́т был уже́ в пе́рвой карти́нке.
sentences.en: In some of them, the answer was already in the first picture.

sentences.en: Steven's goal is lots of content for five or six brands.

sentences.en: Some AI assistants for advertising cost 40 dollars a month.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому Стивен остаётся с Claude, ChatGPT и Gemini.
sentences.en: That's why Steven is sticking with Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.

sentences.zh: Запасной план

sentences.en: Steven wants to automate his work.

sentences.en: He lives in a foreign country.

sentences.zh: С э́тим тру́дно спо́рить.

sentences.en: Steven gives himself one year.

sentences.en: His father would have said: "Look how much you've learned!"

sentences.zh: Но по́сле 40 или 45 лет начина́ешь сомнева́ться.

sentences.en: Steven recommends trying AI for 30 dollars a month.

sentences.en: Claude Cowork is the best.

sentences.en: No company ever gave him a bank card for advertising.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому учи́ться придётся са́мому.
sentences.en: So you have to learn on your own.

sentences.zh: Нача́льником он не стал бы никогда́.
sentences.en: He would never have become a boss.

sentences.en: According to Jean Paul Getty, you can get rich with your own business.

sentences.zh: Его́ де́вушка сейча́с гото́вит у́жин.

sentences.zh: Спаси́бо, дорога́я!
sentences.en: Thank you, dear!

sentences.en: "It's not about the money. It's about the lessons."

sentences.zh: Сочинения и «умный» стиль

sentences.zh: Стивен проверил сочине́ния?
sentences.en: Did Steven grade the essays?

sentences.zh: Нет.
sentences.en: No.

sentences.en: He worked from nine in the morning until two and got exactly half done.

sentences.en: He told the students: "I'll finish by Friday."

sentences.zh: Ещё он гото́вил заня́тие:
sentences.en: He was also preparing a lesson:

sentences.en: a two-part test: reading and listening

sentences.zh: лист про гла́вную мысль для пяти́ текстов семе́стра
sentences.en: a worksheet on the main idea for the semester's five texts

sentences.zh: уро́к про акаде́мический стиль
sentences.en: a lesson on academic style

sentences.zh: В акаде́мическом стиле нельзя́ писа́ть «I'm» вме́сто «I am».
sentences.en: In academic style you can't write "I'm" instead of "I am".

sentences.zh: Нельзя́ писа́ть «you» и «we».
sentences.en: You can't write "you" and "we".

sentences.zh: Нельзя́ писа́ть «по-мо́ему».
sentences.en: You can't write "in my opinion".

sentences.zh: Стивен называ́ет э́то «писа́ть, заду́рив нос».
sentences.en: Steven calls this "writing with your nose in the air."

sentences.zh: Что́бы объясни́ть стиль, Стивен спра́шивает: «Как вы поговори́те с дека́ном? А с дире́ктором Huawei?»
sentences.en: To explain the style, Steven asks: "How would you talk to a dean? And to the director of Huawei?"
